events.headline: Renewing rivalry in Windsor
events.summary: The puck is set to drop on one of hockey’s best rivalry Wednesday, October 28th at the WFCU Centre. The National Women’s Team takes on the United States with the puck dropping at 7 p.m.

events.headline: ‘A special night for our organization’: Flyers go pink Thursday in Leamington
events.summary: Get ready to break out your pink. Pink in the Rink returns Thursday, Oct. 29, when the Leamington Flyers host the Milton Menace at the Nature Fresh Farms Recreation Centre. Puck drop is at 7:10 p.m.
